label: end-of-episode clock (last ~10 trials), D1/D2 steps
explanation: Episode-timing unit. It never fires before trial ~78 of the 100-trial episode: 96% of activation mass falls on trials 90-99, and it ramps up across those trials (magnitude rises step by step within a window toward the episode end). It fires mainly at D1 and D2 and is weak at GO (only 9% of mass). It tracks the collapse in the model value head near the episode end: 97.5% of mass falls on steps with value < 5.22, and none on value > 7.1. (value < 4.6) & (phase != GO) scores slightly higher on dev (F1 0.71 vs 0.68), but I recorded the observable time predicate because value is the model own output. Within the late window, activation is higher after unrewarded trials (D1 with r0, rate 1.3x) and at D2 on S1 (1.6x), but adding those conditions did not raise F1. Precision is limited because the threshold crossing is graded (it misses the first late trials and sits below threshold on some late steps), so this is a ramping magnitude code for time-to-episode-end, not a crisp binary. It does not depend on the good state, the choice, the transition or the stay/switch decision.
